summary: Software Engineer with 3 years building and operating customer-facing authentication platforms at enterprise scale. I work at the protocol level across OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT/JWKS, SSO and federation, and own the security primitives beneath them — PKI, X.509 lifecycle, mTLS, and TLS termination — in production systems where an auth outage blocks customer access. Alongside the day job I build applied AI/ML platforms: agentic RAG, real-time computer vision, and quantitative systems.

experience.title: Software Engineer – Identity & Platform Engineering
description: Own the registration, authentication, and authorization services behind Telstra's customer digital channels — Java and Spring Boot backend services implementing OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect flows, JWT/JWKS validation, token introspection and exchange, session management, MFA, and RBAC.

Migrated 15+ enterprise applications from PCF to OpenShift with zero authentication downtime and no customer-facing incidents, by rebuilding auth integration, secure routing, and IP allow-listing ahead of each cutover.
Eliminated manual certificate renewal as a recurring outage risk by implementing end-to-end mTLS with automated X.509 issuance and rotation, and owning TLS termination at the CDN edge.

Hardened the identity platform's edge by migrating from legacy WAF to AWS CloudFront and WAFv2 — OWASP-aligned custom rule groups, regex pattern sets, IP reputation lists, and rate-based rules — with a phased DNS cutover across 10+ downstream applications at zero downtime.

Standardized SSO and single logout across enterprise apps by configuring OIDC/OAuth 2.0 clients in PingFederate and SecureAuth, and integrating with Salesforce and Entra ID (Azure AD) for identity federation.

Drove platform modernization — Java and Spring Boot upgrades, dependency remediation, CI/CD automation, and vulnerability remediation — reducing security and technical-debt risk across the identity estate.

cloud: AWS (CloudFront, Route 53, S3, IAM, Lambda, CloudWatch)
